title: Space NK’s comparable turnover surges 19% as Ulta Beauty acquisition and new stores drive sales
summary: Space NK, the UK beauty retail chain, reported a 19% rise in comparable turnover to £282.7 million for the nine months ended January 2026, despite operating profit falling 61.3% to £7.4 million

extraction.key_fact: 스페이스 NK의 비교 매출이 늘었고 얼타 뷰티 인수와 신규 매장이 매출을 이끌었다.
